1: * Find tools faster - Search tool names, descriptions and common tasks. Combine All tools or My tools with categories, and keep setup and invoice guides within reach.
2: * Clearer native settings - Add to Cart, More Button Labels, Price Labels and Related Products distinguish essentials from advanced controls. Consequential advanced groups stay open when active or changed. Use Show all settings to see the full native form; unsupported layouts keep their native presentation.
3: * Easier invoice setup - Follow clearer steps to enter details, open a synthetic sample and review supported changes using the existing save, activation and undo flow. Samples do not verify customer email delivery or tax compliance.
4: * Clearer guidance - Selected admin help explains Checkout Blocks support, scenario-check limits and return-request decisions. Existing module limits, permissions and store settings remain in place.
5: * Admin language - Adds Dutch translations for these updated screens, with English fallback elsewhere. Saved merchant content is not translated.
7: * Customer Return Requests - Turn on Return Requests to let signed-in customers request eligible item quantities from completed orders, follow their history and see your decision there. Verified guest access is a separate setup that needs HTTPS. Approval records your decision; it does not refund money, restock products or process a payment.
8: * Checkout Blocks - Collect supported checkout file uploads and show your Place order button text in the WooCommerce Checkout block, alongside existing supported custom fields. Existing module and edition limits still apply; this does not make every Booster option or third-party checkout compatible.
9: * Order and payment reliability - Use WooCommerce order data in affected HPOS exports and reports. Keep Booster gateway fees in sync when an eligible unpaid order changes payment method, without replacing unrelated custom fees.
10: * Understand gateway fees - See why a configured fee applies to a sample guest purchase, and check a summary of your latest up to 50 return requests. These read-only views do not change a shopper cart or predict the final checkout total. Booster Elite adds role and product facts, fee comparisons and payment/shipping rule scenarios.
11: * Hosting requirements - Requires PHP 7.3 or later on a 64-bit build with native integer hrtime() enabled. Use a maintained PHP release supported by your WordPress and WooCommerce versions.
13: * Store updates, without dashboard clutter - Receive short Booster news only on Booster settings pages. Each user can permanently dismiss a notice; store and checkout settings are unchanged.
16: * Wishlist control - Choose to keep saved products after adding them to the cart. Removal remains enabled by default, including after upgrade; disable "Remove from wishlist after adding to cart" to preserve items. Explicit removal still works.
17: * Shipping setup - Clearer guidance shows how separate category and minimum-order free-shipping methods can offer either route without duplicate free options. Existing shipping rules are not changed automatically.
18: * Security - Strengthened handling of customer-supplied product details and document processing to help keep stores protected. Updating is recommended.
19: * Branded document setup - Enter plain business details and an optional supported local logo, open a real synthetic sample, and review exact setting changes before enabling the chosen operation.
20: * Edition scope - The Light guide supports the Invoice document type, generated manually or on completed orders, with optional attachment to the customer completed-order email.
21: * Merchant control - Sample and attachment rehearsal do not send email, issue production documents or consume invoice numbers. Existing numbering, tax, advanced settings and custom templates are protected; settings undo detects later changes.
22: * Dutch continuity - Adds reviewed Dutch translations across selected core modules and the new setup guide, with English fallback outside the bounded coverage. Merchant-authored content and saved PDF templates are not translated; community and custom language overrides retain priority.
23: * Clear limits - The starter layout needs no HTML editing, but custom layouts remain in advanced settings. Sample success and attachment rehearsal do not confirm production email delivery or tax/legal compliance.
24: * Storefront continuity - Keeps setup redirects out of customer background requests after activation, so saved-list actions can work immediately.
